item: Author's royalties from literary works (derechos de autor por creación literaria)
value: 42,000 EUR received in 2022 (asset and income declaration of 9 August 2023)
detail: Declared under 'F) Actividades de producción y creación literaria' in the Congress register of activities. His declaration of economic interests of 9 August 2023 lists author's royalties from the publisher Ediciones 62 S.A. (2019–present) and states that the after-tax profit from the book is donated to Obra Social NUR. His asset and income declarations report royalties received of 16,666.66 EUR in 2018 and 42,000 EUR in 2022.

item: Contributions to Obra Social NUR and to the PSOE
value: Book profits after tax (Obra Social NUR); statutory member and office-holder fees (PSOE)
detail: Section III of his declaration of economic interests lists the donation of the book's after-tax profits to Obra Social NUR and the membership fee and office-holder contribution set by the PSOE's statutes. Section II declares no gifts or unpaid benefits received in the previous five years ('Ninguno'). His asset declaration of August 2023 lists 4,418.40 EUR of donations to the PSOE and others.

item: Rental of a home that is not his main residence
period: 2015–2019 (declared February 2021); rental income also declared for 2022
detail: His XIV Legislature declaration of economic interests lists, for 2015–2019, the rental of a home that was not his habitual residence, as a private individual with no conflict of interest. Rental income appears in his asset and income declarations of May 2019 and August 2023.
